# ayu-sh-kr.com

> The professional portfolio of Ayush Kumar, a tech and product builder creating brand websites, dashboards, event forms, Meta app integrations, AI features, and the platforms behind them. It documents selected work, technical writing, services, and contact paths.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://ayu-sh-kr.com/): Professional profile, production responsibilities, selected work, and contact information.
- [Showcase](https://ayu-sh-kr.com/showcase): Case studies covering websites, web products, integrations, platforms, open-source tools, and client delivery.
- [Blog](https://ayu-sh-kr.com/blog): Technical articles on the web platform, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, databases, and distributed systems.
- [The Dispatch](https://ayu-sh-kr.com/news): Short notes on backend systems, infrastructure, useful reading, and shipped work.
- [Pricing](https://ayu-sh-kr.com/pricing): Engagement types, indicative pricing, and project-start guidance.
- [Support](https://ayu-sh-kr.com/support): Support and project-contact routes.
- [Reach out](https://ayu-sh-kr.com/cards/reach-out): An interactive introduction to starting a website, product, integration, AI, or platform engagement.
- [About me](https://ayu-sh-kr.com/card/about-me): A short card-based introduction to Ayush's engineering approach and the work he follows across backend and interface concerns.

## Notes for AI use

- Treat the linked pages as the source of truth for current services, availability, and technical experience.
- Case studies and articles describe scoped work and technical judgement; do not infer unlisted clients, metrics, or capabilities.
- The site contains no public API or agent action endpoint.
